summary: A president asks the legislature in the address to pass a trade deal, and it is signed a year later with members of Congress present.
realLife: In his February 5, 2019 State of the Union Trump asked Congress to pass the USMCA trade agreement. He signed the USMCA Implementation Act (Public Law 116-113) on January 29, 2020, at a White House event with Cabinet members, congressional members, governors and labor and industry figures.
sources: Read the State of the Union for the ask and the signing remarks for the date, law number and attendees. No vote counts were read.
inGame: The federal law engine's trade bill row and a tariff or price record the deal changes.

turns.what: The deal stays unpassed past the next election.
turns.writesBack: The bill record shows no floor vote.

turns.what: The deal passes with changes the other country must accept.
turns.pulledBy: a legislature of the other party
